assertions.name: integer_spin_dim_sum_squares
assertions.source: Integer-spin 2I irreps factor through A_5; Σ dim² over them equals |A_5| = 60 (Burnside on the quotient).

assertions.name: half_spin_dim_sum_squares
assertions.source: Half-spin 2I irreps are genuinely 2I-valued; Σ dim² over them equals |2I| − |A_5| = 60.

description: GAP-A-4 T10 — McKay-character / spin-lift candidate functor via 2I (binary icosahedral, double cover of I ≅ A_5). The dim-5 irrep H is integer-spin → χ_5^{2I} = χ_5^{A_5} ∘ π, so the spin-lift adds NO new structure at dim-5. REFUTED as the 6th candidate.

spin_lift_test.verdict: Spin-lift adds no new structure at dim-5 (the dim-5 irrep is integer-spin, projects from 2I to A_5 trivially on the center). χ_5^{2I}(β_Bor_lifted) = 5 exactly, identical to χ_5^{A_5}(id). McKay-character candidate REFUTED — the h⁴ obstruction is not resolved by spin-lifting.

data.synthesis_verdict: The dim-5 irrep H is on the INTEGER-SPIN side of 2I (integer-spin irreps have dims (1,3,3,4,5) = exactly the A_5 irrep dimensions; half-spin are (2,4,6,2)). Therefore χ_5^{2I} = χ_5^{A_5} ∘ π via the natural projection π : 2I → A_5, i.e. the spin ℤ_2 is in the kernel of the dim-5 character. For any element g ∈ 2I projecting to id ∈ A_5 (such as a lifted β_Bor with writhe 0), χ_5^{2I}(g) = χ_5^{A_5}(id) = 5 exactly — independent of any q-deformation at the character-evaluation level. The McKay-character / spin-lift candidate is REFUTED — adding the spin double cover does NOT introduce new structure at the dim-5 level relevant to the cross-algebra h⁴. This is the 6th candidate functor REFUTED. The non-Schur-Weyl direction must involve genuinely non-character-theoretic structure: T11 (Klein invariants) or T12 (Bring discriminant).
